schema.description: A single floating-point number on a single line, representing the computed adsorbed finite-difference derivative of the parallel polarizability α∥ for H2 (v=0→1) in units e²a₀²E_h⁻¹.

outputs.description: The key result demonstrating that the adsorption-induced change in the slope parameter b is negligible; the value should closely match the paper's reported semi-harmonic estimate. The checker compares this scalar to the hidden paper-gold value within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The intermediate correction log (correction_log.txt) is produced for transparency but not scored. Only the final derivative scalar is verified against the paper's result.

steps.description: Compare the agent's computed derivative to the paper's target value.
